scope: PWC-03A.3 synthetic contract fixtures; placeholders are not credentials

transport.web/login/: browser issuance; exact configured HTTPS portal + CSRF; no Authorization
transport.mobile/login/: native issuance; no session cookie or Authorization or browser provenance
transport.mobile/refresh/: native explicit body refresh proof only
transport.logout/: exactly one cookie OR Bearer; browser CSRF
transport.logout-all/: exactly one cookie OR Bearer; browser CSRF; step-up denial in this slice
transport.sessions/{id}/: exactly one cookie OR Bearer; browser CSRF; ownership then step-up denial

refresh_lost_response: clear local secrets and re-login; retry of consumed refresh revokes that family
idle_renewal: GET/status/list/refresh never renew; no heartbeat accepted
